boundaryRules.name: Strict Loopback Host Binding
boundaryRules.enforcement: Vite dev/preview server MUST bind exclusively to 127.0.0.1, never 0.0.0.0

boundaryRules.name: Dedicated Port Reservation
boundaryRules.enforcement: Port 60135 with strictPort: true to prevent auto-increment fallback

boundaryRules.name: Origin Verification
boundaryRules.enforcement: FastAPI backend validates Origin == http://127.0.0.1:60135 for privileged actions

boundaryRules.name: Zero Public Deployment
boundaryRules.enforcement: Admin assets are excluded from user build pipelines and cloud CD workflows
